description:
[Trading Data API] Spot-vs-perp basis (premium %) with funding-implied annualized carry. Spot from Coinbase; perp marks from Binance + Bybit.

**Example:** `/v1/basis?symbol=BTC`

Use when you want the spot-vs-perp premium and funding-implied annualized carry for a basis trade. Not for raw funding data (use funding_oi).

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).
name: basis
